name: com_jogo_salvo
doc: Stands in for saves/com_jogo_salvo.state (and the place of saves/eq_spare.state): the party (Crono, Lucca, Frog) walks back out of the Cathedral (loc 082 -> 081 -> the south door) onto the 600 A.D. overworld (loc 1F1, $0105 = 081) and stops at the reference's spot (232,336). Storyline 15. eq_spare's inventory (02 03 05 5B 5C 7C 95 96 at the same 1105 G) is not reproduced: no purchase path gives it.
